[SWS_DM_02134] Reporting "DoIP header check failed" to IdsM
Upstream requirements:
RS_Ids_00810
⌈
If a DoIP message is rejected based on an invalid "DoIP generic header", the DM
shall report a security event SEV_DOIP_HEADER_CHECK_FAILED to IdsM (see [26]
and table [SWS_DM_02135]) with the context data given in [SWS_DM_02135].
⌋
The DoIP generic header check is described in ISO 13400-2 in the figure "DoIP generic
header handler".
[SWS_DM_02135] Security event context data definition: SEV_DOIP_HEADER_
CHECK_FAILED
